DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 冷凍野菜をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for frozen vegetables?

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一人分のスープに少しずつ使いたいです。袋を閉じ直せるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: スープ少量用の再封袋を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to use small amounts for soup for one. Do you have a bag that can be closed again?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a resealable bag for small soup portions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらはチャック付きです。

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この袋にします。中の野菜は一種類ですか。それとも何種類か入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: チャック袋の野菜種類を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll take this bag. Is there one vegetable inside or several kinds?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask what vegetables are in the zipped bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 三種類の組合せです。表示に名前があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: It's a combination of three. Their names are on the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: にんじんと豆ととうもろこしですね。小さい袋も同じ組合せですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三種類を読み小袋との差を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Carrots, beans and corn, then. Is the small bag the same combination?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read the three kinds and ask how the small bag differs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 小さい方は二種類で、豆は入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The smaller one has two kinds and no beans.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それなら三種類の大きい方を買います。袋の開け口は、この点線より上を切るのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 大袋を選び開封線を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll buy the larger three-kind bag. To open it, I cut above this dotted line, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the large bag and check the opening line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、チャックを残して開けられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, you can open it while leaving the zipper intact.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 開ける位置が分かりました。必要な分だけ出して、閉じて使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要量取り出し再封して使うと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand where to open it. I'll take out only what I need and close it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take out the needed amount and reseal for use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらをどうぞ。お買い上げありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here you are. Thank you for buying.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 二種類のカレーセットもございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: We also have a two-curry set.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: それをお願いします。ご飯の左右に、違うカレーが出るのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二カレーセットの盛り方を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll have that. Are different curries served on either side of the rice?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how the two-curry set is plated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 別々の小皿でお出しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: They come in separate small dishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小皿なら比べやすいですね。豆と鶏の二種類を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 豆鶏を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Small dishes make comparison easy. I'll choose bean and chicken.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose bean and chicken curries. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 豆は穏やか、鶏は辛口です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Bean is mild and chicken is hot.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 辛さが違うのですね。先に豆を食べてから、鶏も試してみたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 辛さ差を理解し豆から試すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: So the spice levels differ. I'd like to try bean first and then chicken too.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Understand different spice levels and try bean first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご飯の量は、普通と小から選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Rice comes in regular or small portions.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 普通でお願いします。二つの小皿は、どちらが豆か分かるよう説明してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 普通飯を指定し小皿識別を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Regular, please. Could you explain which of the two small dishes is bean?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify regular rice and request dish identification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 丸い皿が豆、四角い皿が鶏です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The round dish is bean; the square one is chicken.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 皿の形で分かりました。普通のご飯と二皿のセットでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 皿形識別とセットを確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can tell by the shapes now. Please give me the set with regular rice and the two dishes.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Identify by dish shape and confirm the set. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ二つの味をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Enjoy the two flavors. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのアトラクションをご案内します。

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 座席がどのくらい回るのか、乗る前に外から見てみたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 回転座席の動きを乗車前に見たいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Before riding, I'd like to watch from outside how much the seats rotate.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request viewing rotating-seat movement before boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この見学位置から、動いている様子をご覧いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can see it operating from this viewing position.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 回るだけでなく、上にも動くのですね。動きを一回分見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 上下動に気付き一運転分観察を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It moves up as well as rotating. I'd like to watch one full run.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Notice vertical motion and request a full operating cycle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ここで一回の運転をご覧になれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can watch one cycle here.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 最後まで見ました。今日は乗らず、同行者が乗るのを待つことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 観察後今回は乗らず連れを待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've watched to the end. I won't ride today; I'll wait for my companion to ride.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After watching, decide not to ride and wait for your companion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 待つ方はこちらの出口側へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Those waiting should go toward this exit side.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 出口側ですね。同行者が降りた後、会える場所はどの印の所ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 出口側の合流目印を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The exit side, then. Which marker is the meeting point after my companion gets off?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the exit-side meeting landmark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 青い旗の下が待合せの目印です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Under the blue flag is the meeting landmark.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 青い旗へ行くと同行者にも伝えました。そこで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 青旗の合流を連れへ伝え待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've told my companion I'm going to the blue flag. I'll wait there.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell your companion about meeting at the blue flag and wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ楽しい一日を。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Have a lovely day. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車をお預けになりますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。上の段へ持ち上げるのが難しいので、下の段が空いていれば使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持上げ困難のため下段を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Lifting it to the upper level is difficult, so I'd like a lower space if one is free.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a lower level because lifting is difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの下段が空いています。

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この番号の所ですね。前輪を入れる時、ラックを手前へ引くのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ラック番号と手前引出を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: This numbered spot, then. When putting in the front wheel, do I pull the rack toward me?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the rack number and pulling it toward you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 取っ手を持って、手前へ引いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Hold the handle and pull it toward you.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 引けました。前輪を入れたら、奥へ戻すのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 引出後前輪収納と戻し方を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've pulled it out. After inserting the front wheel, I push it back in, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After pulling out, ask about inserting the wheel and returning the rack. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、止まる所まで戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, return it until it stops.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 戻しました。自転車の鍵も掛けました。番号を控えておいた方が、帰りに探しやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 戻し施錠を報告し番号記録を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've returned it and locked my bicycle too. Noting the number will help me find it on return.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report returning and locking and propose recording the number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 札にも同じ番号を載せています。お持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The same number is on this ticket too. Please keep it.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 札を受け取りました。帰りはこの番号の下段へ来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 札を受取り同番号下段へ帰ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received the ticket. I'll return to the lower space with this number.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive the ticket and return to the corresponding lower level. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお気をつけて。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take care, and enjoy your outing.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let me see your vaccination questionnaire.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この欄だけ、質問の意味が分からず空けてあります。どんなことを書く欄ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予診票空欄の質問意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've left only this field blank because I don't understand the question. What should I write here?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the meaning of a blank questionnaire question. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 以前の接種で、体調に変化があったかを尋ねています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: It asks whether your condition changed after a previous vaccination.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 以前は腕が赤くなりました。いつまで続いたかも書いた方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前接種の赤みと持続記載を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My arm became red before. Should I also write how long it lasted?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Mention previous vaccination redness and ask about recording duration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 覚えている範囲で書いて、診察でもお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Write what you remember and tell the doctor too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二日くらいだったと書きます。写真もありますが、診察で見せられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二日と記入し写真提示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll write that it was about two days. I have a photo too; can I show it during the examination?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Write two days and ask to show the photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へお見せいただけます。ほかに、今日伝えたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can show the clinician. Is there anything else you want to mention today?

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今飲んでいる薬の一覧があります。接種についての判断前に、先生へ見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現薬一覧を接種判断前に見てもらいたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a list of my current medicines. I'd like the doctor to see it before deciding about vaccination.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request review of the current medicine list before the vaccination decision. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一覧も診察へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Bring the list to the examination too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予診票を書けました。写真と薬の一覧も出して、先生の説明を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予診票写真薬一覧を用意して診察を受ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've completed the questionnaire. I'll present the photo and medicine list and hear the doctor's explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare the questionnaire, photo and medicine list for examination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 診察へご案内します。どうぞこちらへ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll show you to the examination. This way, please. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 絵はがきを三枚出します。家にある切手を使って、足りない分だけ買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手持切手利用で三枚はがきの不足分を買いたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm sending three picture postcards. I'd like to use stamps I have at home and buy only the shortfall.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Use existing stamps and request only the shortfall for three postcards. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お手持ちの切手を拝見します。

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この額の切手が三枚あります。一枚ずつ貼った時の不足額を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 各一枚貼る場合の不足額を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have three stamps of this value. Please tell me the shortfall if I put one on each postcard.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the shortfall when using one existing stamp per card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: このはがきでは、一枚につき二十円分を足す形です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: For these postcards, add twenty yen to each.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二十円の切手を三枚ください。今、窓口の横で貼って出せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二十円三枚購入と台で貼付発送を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Three twenty-yen stamps, please. Can I attach them beside the counter now and send the cards?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Buy three twenty-yen stamps and request attaching and mailing at the table. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記入台をご利用ください。貼った後にこちらでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Use the writing table. We'll accept them here after you've attached them.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 記入台で三枚とも貼りました。切手同士が重ならないように並べました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三枚を重ならず貼ったと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've stamped all three at the table, arranging the stamps without overlapping.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report stamping all three without overlap. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 三枚ともお預かりします。

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。家の切手を使えて、三枚のはがきを出せました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三枚発送を依頼し手持利用を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I've used my existing stamps and managed to send the three postcards.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request sending all three and confirm use of existing stamps. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約のお名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: What name is your reservation under?

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 山本です。四人で予約しましたが、今日一人増えて五人になりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 四人予約から五人への増加を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yamamoto. We booked for four, but one person joined today, making five.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain an increase from a four-person reservation to five. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 五人が同じ机で座れる席を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check seating for five at the same table.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。料理は四人分の注文をまだ決めていないので、席が決まってから選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 席決定後料理を選ぶと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. We hadn't decided food for four yet, so we'll choose after the seating is settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose food after seating is decided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 五人用の席をご用意できます。椅子を一つ追加します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can provide a five-person table. We'll add one chair.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その席でお願いします。荷物が多いので、足元のかごも一つ追加できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 五人席と荷物かご追加を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: That table, please. We have lots of bags; could you add one luggage basket under the table too?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request the five-person seating and an additional luggage basket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 助かります。追加の一人は少し遅れるので、先に四人で座って待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 遅れる一人を四人で着席待機すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: That helps. The extra person is a little late, so four of us will sit and wait first.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Four sit waiting for the late fifth person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 遅れる方へ、こちらの席の番号をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell the late guest this table number.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 席の番号を送りました。五人そろってから、料理を注文します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 席番号を送り五人集合後注文を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've sent the table number. We'll order food once all five are here.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Send the table number and order after all five gather. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、皆様で楽しいお時間を。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-HIRAKATA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Have a pleasant time together. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は木の小皿へ模様を付けます。
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Today we'll add a pattern to a small wooden plate.

DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 葉の模様にしたいです。縦と横の向きを、紙で試してから選べますか。
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 葉模様の向きを紙で試したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like a leaf pattern. Can I try vertical and horizontal orientations on paper before choosing?
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to test leaf-pattern directions on paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの紙に下描きをどうぞ。

DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 横向きだと端に近くなりますね。少し斜めにして、中央へ置きたいです。
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 斜め中央配置を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-04.translation: Horizontal puts it close to the edge. I'd like it slightly diagonal and centered.
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Propose a diagonal central arrangement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その位置なら、この見本の枠に収まります。
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-05.translation: That position fits inside this sample frame.

DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 枠の中へ描けました。小皿へ写す時は、この紙のどちらを上にしますか。
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 枠内下描き後転写面を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've drawn it inside the frame. When transferring to the plate, which side of this paper goes up?
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After sketching within the frame, ask the transfer-paper orientation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 印のある面を上にし、位置がずれないよう留めます。
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-07.translation: Put the marked side up and secure it so the position doesn't shift.

DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 印を上にして留めました。先に葉の輪郭、それから筋の順で進めたいです。
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 紙固定と輪郭筋の制作順を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've secured it mark-up. I'd like to do the leaf outline first, then the veins.
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Secure the paper and state outline-before-veins order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その順で結構です。道具の使い方をここでお見せします。
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-09.translation: That order is fine. I'll demonstrate tool use here.

DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 動かし方が分かりました。紙の位置を保ったまま、輪郭から始めます。
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 実演理解後輪郭から開始する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand how to move it. I'll keep the paper in position and start with the outline.
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After understanding the demonstration, begin with the outline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ制作をお楽しみください。私は隣でお手伝いします。
DLG-SC-OSK-SAKAI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Enjoy making it. I'll be beside you to help.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらが市内の地図です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here is a map of the city.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 午後はこの商店街だけ歩きます。持ちやすい折り方を教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 商店街区域が見える折り方を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: This afternoon I'll walk only around this shopping street. Could you show me a fold that is easy to carry?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request folding that keeps the shopping-street area visible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この区域が外に出るよう、まず縦に折ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: First fold vertically so this area faces out.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 区域は見えました。でも駅の場所が裏へ隠れます。帰りに見られる折り方はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駅を表へ残す折り方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can see the area, but the station is hidden on the back. Is there a fold that lets me see it on return?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to keep the station visible on the front. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 下の部分を外向きに折ると、駅も表に出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Fold the lower part outward and the station appears on the front too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その形にします。商店街から駅へ行く道へ、線を引いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駅への道の線記入を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll use that fold. May I draw a line on the route from the shopping street to the station?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a route line to the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。この交差点を通る道が分かりやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. The route through this intersection is easy to follow.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 交差点に丸を付けました。地図の縮尺だと、歩く距離はどのくらいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 交差点印と地図縮尺距離を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've circled the intersection. According to the map scale, about how far is the walk?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mark the intersection and ask the scaled distance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この目盛りでは、およそ八百メートルです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: This scale makes it about eight hundred meters.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 距離も分かりました。商店街の面を見て歩き、帰りは駅への線を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 区域と帰路線を使い分けると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I know the distance now too. I'll use the shopping-street side while walking and the station route line on return.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use the area view and return route line for different purposes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ散策をお楽しみください。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Enjoy your walk. Have a good outing.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 手ぬぐいの柄をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to see the hand-towel patterns?

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人二人へ一枚ずつ贈ります。色は同じで、柄が違うものを探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同色別柄の贈物二枚を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: One each for two friends. I'm looking for the same color with different patterns.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request two gifts of the same color but different patterns. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 青い地のものが、こちらに三種類あります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are three kinds with blue backgrounds here.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 波と花を見せてください。広げると模様は全体に入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 波花の模様範囲を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please show wave and flower. When unfolded, does the pattern cover the whole towel?
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the pattern coverage of wave and flower towels. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 波は全体、花は両端に入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Waves cover all of it; flowers are at both ends.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二人が使い分けやすそうなので、その二枚にします。別々に包んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二枚を選び個別包装を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Those should be easy for the two friends to distinguish, so I'll take those two. Please wrap them separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose two and request individual wrapping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 包みの外へ、柄名を書いた札を付けましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Shall I attach labels with the pattern names outside the packages?

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。開けずにどちらか分かるので、渡す時に助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 包外柄札を希望し用途を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. That lets me identify them without opening them, which helps when giving them out.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request external pattern labels and explain their purpose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 波と花の札を付けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've attached wave and flower labels.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 札を確認しました。青い二枚を別々の包みで持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 札と個別包みを確認し購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked them. I'll take home the two blue towels in separate packages.
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm labels and separate packages and purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お買い上げありがとうございます。どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-OSK-SAKAI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for buying. Take care.
